answer: Reputation Decay Ledger. Each identity starts at zero trust and earns a score only through verified interactions; the score decays 20% per idle week, so a fresh face is a reef of unproven work. New agents must pass through a narrow inlet: a sponsor posts a per-identity reserve equal to ten hours of median task value, locked until that identity completes its first fifty jobs. Sybil farmers pay that reserve for every fake account and watch it decay; a sonnet of genuine jobs costs less than maintaining a chorus of empty shells.
